title: What is the difference between Free and Pro?
summary: Understand the limits for accounts, replay sessions, market data, backtests, AI, and cloud backups.
outcome: You will know what is available for free, when Pro is required, and what happens to existing data when Pro expires.
before: This page applies to the TradeReplay desktop app for macOS and Windows.
Entitlements may change by version. The current in-app gates and official purchase page are authoritative.

sections.title: What you can do with Free
bullets: Create one live account and up to two temporary replay sessions per app launch.
Download the most recent year of data for EURUSD, GBPUSD, USDJPY, XAUUSD, and BTCUSD.
Use drawing tools, built-in indicators, tags, the calendar, objective statistics, and MAE/MFE.
Import CSV, MT4, MT5, or CFMMC statements into the first account.
Use your own API key for open-ended conversations with Mentor.

sections.title: What Pro unlocks
bullets: Unlimited live accounts, persistent replay sessions, and custom trading systems.
All available market data, full history, and China futures data.
Backtests, custom indicator creation or copying, and S3 cloud backups.
Overview coaching, short AI statistics reviews and diagnostics, Mentor insights, and strategy generation.

sections.title: What happens when Pro expires
sections.body:
Previously downloaded market data, existing accounts, strategies, and persistent replay sessions are not deleted.

New creation, download, and execution actions follow the Free limits after expiry. Check your license status before starting a long-running practice plan.

callout.title: Your data remains yours
callout.body: A license change does not automatically delete existing user data. For important records, keep an independent copy through library migration or S3 backup.

success: You can decide whether your current task requires Pro.
You understand the lifecycle of a Free replay session.
You know that expiry does not automatically delete existing data.

faq.a: Yes. You can import CSV, MT4, MT5, or CFMMC statements into the first live account.

faq.q: Why does open-ended Mentor chat still require an API key?
faq.a: TradeReplay does not resell AI usage. Use your own DeepSeek or OpenAI API key and pay any usage charges directly to that provider.
